description: ID-One Cosmo V8.1 is a dual interface (ISO 7816 & ISO 14443) smartcard hardware platform compliant with Javacard 3.0.1 and GlobalPlatform 2.2.1 which includes a NIST SP800-90 compliant DRBG relying on block cipher AES, thus providing security strength of 17.
version: HW = ‘30’ with FW = ‘5F01’ and HW = ‘40’ with FW = ‘6001’ 07831.6 (Firmware)
